purpose: Paper-ready training diagnostics package: plots, reports, summaries, and evaluation diagnostics from the final run directories used by Report_paper_9model benchmark.

policy.included: plots/figures, model summary images/PDFs, report markdown/text, config/meta/history logs, test summary JSON/MD, small evaluation spreadsheets.
policy.skipped: model/checkpoint artifacts, best_model directories, per-epoch prediction JSON, full predictions.csv, full eval CSV >1MB, files over 10MB.
policy.rationale: Keep paper evidence and plots in GitHub while leaving model weights and bulky full prediction tables for Hugging Face/external artifact storage.
